subject: derived_tests
summary: Derived Vitest suite keeps W1 pre/post coverage and elevates W2 to first-class checks: named InsufficientStockError (not PreconditionError/builtins), NoHoldCreatedOnInsufficientStock (empty and with prior hold), and AvailableStockUnchangedOnInsufficientStock. OCL failure-path posts are exercised; not happy-path-only.

findings.detail: lint: ambiguous phrase 'sufficient' in Brief scope text
lint: overlapping touches across W2–W5 (and with W1); solidsdd-run must serialize these items
The early SufficientAvailableStock pre case only asserts throw(InsufficientStockError); stock/hold immutability is covered by dedicated W2 post cases, so checkability remains.
No explicit success case at availableStock == quantity (boundary of SufficientAvailableStock); happy-path cases use available > quantity only.
